g.text: Title: 24 VAC input and logic supply

g.desc: Title: 24 VAC input and logic supply

g.text: Paper design. Never built, nothing measured.

g.desc: Paper design. Never built, nothing measured.

g.text: Generated from design/circuit.py and hardware/netlist.yaml. Do not edit by hand.

g.desc: Generated from design/circuit.py and hardware/netlist.yaml. Do not edit by hand.

g.style: fill:#FFFFC2; fill-opacity:1.0000; stroke:none;

g.text: Half-wave rectifier, bulk capacitor, supply monitor

g.desc: Half-wave rectifier, bulk capacitor, supply monitor

g.text: 24 VAC input: a fuse in each leg, surge clamp

g.desc: 24 VAC input: a fuse in each leg, surge clamp

g.text: U1 LM5164, 100 V synchronous buck (TI SNVSAU4D). It survives the 77.4 V clamp level.

g.desc: U1 LM5164, 100 V synchronous buck (TI SNVSAU4D). It survives the 77.4 V clamp level.

g.text: V_BUCK = 1.2 V x (1 + (R3 + R4) / R5) = 5.28 V, 5.16 to 5.40 V over tolerance.

g.desc: V_BUCK = 1.2 V x (1 + (R3 + R4) / R5) = 5.28 V, 5.16 to 5.40 V over tolerance.

g.text: R2 47k sets the on-time: 281 kHz. R7, R8: on at 9.0 V, off at 8.4 V.

g.desc: R2 47k sets the on-time: 281 kHz. R7, R8: on at 9.0 V, off at 8.4 V.

g.text: C4 2.2 nF bootstrap. The datasheet fixes this value; a larger one damages the part.

g.desc: C4 2.2 nF bootstrap. The datasheet fixes this value; a larger one damages the part.

g.text: R6, C7, C8 Type 3 ripple injection: 24 mV at FB at 34 V in, 13 mV at 10 V.

g.desc: R6, C7, C8 Type 3 ripple injection: 24 mV at FB at 34 V in, 13 mV at 10 V.

g.text: L1 47 uH, Isat 2.0 A. Ripple 0.34 A, peak 0.99 A against a 1.25 A current limit.

g.desc: L1 47 uH, Isat 2.0 A. Ripple 0.34 A, peak 0.99 A against a 1.25 A current limit.

g.text: Load on V_BUCK: 0.28 A typical, 0.78 A peak (section 4.2). It also feeds the relay coil and

g.desc: Load on V_BUCK: 0.28 A typical, 0.78 A peak (section 4.2). It also feeds the relay coil and

g.text: the sensor supply directly, and V5 through D3 on the USB sheet.

g.desc: the sensor supply directly, and V5 through D3 on the USB sheet.

g.text: LAYOUT: C2 and C3 at U1 pins 2 and 1 with the shortest loop. Keep the SW node small and away

g.desc: LAYOUT: C2 and C3 at U1 pins 2 and 1 with the shortest loop. Keep the SW node small and away

g.text: from the current-sense parts. PWR_FLAG marks nets that are fed through a passive part.

g.desc: from the current-sense parts. PWR_FLAG marks nets that are fed through a passive part.

g.text: 24 VAC INPUT AND LOGIC SUPPLY (hardware design section 4).

g.desc: 24 VAC INPUT AND LOGIC SUPPLY (hardware design section 4).

g.text: F4, F1 3 A time-lag fuses in holders, one in each transformer leg (section 5.3 says why two).

g.desc: F4, F1 3 A time-lag fuses in holders, one in each transformer leg (section 5.3 says why two).

g.text: Terminal 2, AC_N, becomes circuit GND behind F1. Both holders sit in the fuse well behind J1.

g.desc: Terminal 2, AC_N, becomes circuit GND behind F1. Both holders sit in the fuse well behind J1.

g.text: D1 SMCJ48CA: stands off 48 V, above the 45.3 V peak of 32 VAC. Clamps at 77.4 V.

g.desc: D1 SMCJ48CA: stands off 48 V, above the 45.3 V peak of 32 VAC. Clamps at 77.4 V.

g.text: D2, R1 Half-wave rectifier. R1 is the surge-rated SR2512JK (5 %), not the FK (1 %) part:

g.desc: D2, R1 Half-wave rectifier. R1 is the surge-rated SR2512JK (5 %), not the FK (1 %) part:

g.text: it takes 237 to 385 W for about 1 ms when the board is plugged in at the mains peak.

g.desc: it takes 237 to 385 W for about 1 ms when the board is plugged in at the mains peak.

g.text: C1 470 uF 63 V, through-hole, on the bottom side lying down. VIN_DC is 26 to 31 V at 24 VAC

g.desc: C1 470 uF 63 V, through-hole, on the bottom side lying down. VIN_DC is 26 to 31 V at 24 VAC

g.text: and 44 V at 32 VAC with no load. Ripple 0.16 A typical, 0.48 A at the peak corner.

g.desc: and 44 V at 32 VAC with no load. Ripple 0.16 A typical, 0.48 A at the peak corner.

g.text: R9, R10 VIN_MON = VIN_DC / 31 to GPIO3: about 0.97 V at 24 VAC, 1.43 V at 32 VAC.

g.desc: R9, R10 VIN_MON = VIN_DC / 31 to GPIO3: about 0.97 V at 24 VAC, 1.43 V at 32 VAC.
